answer: Sybil resistance via garden-plot anchoring: each agent tends a garden plot secured by a delta stake of 16,000 POA for 18 epochs; the stake decays 5% per epoch unless renewed by valid work proofs. A dune of 13 rotating gardeners audits each harvest; inconsistent plots are cleared and the delta stake burns 27%. An attacker running N sybils must fund 16,000N POA for 18 epochs and survive 13 dune audits per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
